about.intro: The Jordan Restaurant Association (JRA) is a mandatory, not-for-profit membership association empowered by Law No. 47 of 2002, amended by Law No. 33 of 2018 and Bylaw No. 59 of 2025. JRA represents over 1,300 classified establishments — restaurants, entertainment cities, coffee shops, fast food, discos, bars, and cabarets rated 1 to 5 stars — and is a member of the Jordan Tourism Board and an affiliate of UN Tourism.

membership.intro: Joining the Jordan Restaurant Association is one of the smartest investments you can make for your establishment's success — advocacy, classification support, training, and a directory presence that reaches visitors and residents across Jordan. Submit your details below and our membership team will follow up.

classification.heroTitle: Know exactly where your establishment stands
classification.heroBody: JRA classifies tourist restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and entertainment venues from 1 to 5 stars against official published standards. Score your own establishment against the real criteria before applying — building & facade, service, dining hall, kitchen, staff, and food quality all count toward your rating.
classification.noAccountNote: No account needed — this is for anyone considering joining. Already a member? Your portal saves an official-facing version tied to your restaurant.
